top.why: ENFEN expects the extraordinary coastal El Niño to last until February 2027, prolonging pressure on Peruvian anchovy, the main raw material for fishmeal and fish oil.
Mowi reported a record Q3 with operating profit up 146% and raised its 2026 harvest guidance to 620,000 tonnes.
Bakkafrost's Q3 operating profit rose to €17m but shares fell on weaker-than-expected figures, and it sees global supply falling 3% in Q4 with demand holding firm.
BioMar sold 488 thousand tonnes of feed in Q3, raised full-year revenue and EBIT guidance, but expects a softer Q4 amid uncertainty over ingredient prices.
SalMar harvested a record 105,100 gutted tonnes in Q3 and doubled operating profit to NOK 1.6 billion, while guidance stays at 347,000 tonnes for 2026 and 348,000 for 2027.
